name: ApprovalCard
description: The gate in front of something an agent wants to do: what it is, and the two answers.

props.name: title
props.description: What is about to happen, in one line. It names the card.

props.name: description
props.description: The consequence, where a title cannot carry it: what this will change, and whether it can be undone.

props.name: input
props.description: The call itself, shown the way a `ToolCallCard` shows its input.

props.name: decision
props.description: Controlled: what has been decided. `null` is "not yet", and is what shows the two buttons.

props.name: onDecisionChange
props.description: Fires when a button is pressed, with the decision and which button made it.

props.name: busy
props.description: The decision is on its way to a server: both buttons are disabled and the card reports `aria-busy`.

props.name: approveLabel
props.description: What the approving button says. Default `Approve`.

props.name: rejectLabel
props.description: What the refusing button says. Default `Reject`.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to put focus on the card when it mounts. Default `false` — an agent's turn arrives while the reader is somewhere else, and taking focus from them is how a decision gets pressed by accident. It lands on the *reject* button, which is APG's rule for a decision: the least destructive action.

props.name: valueLimit
props.description: How much of the input is shown before it is cut. Default `AgentUtils.VALUE_LIMIT`.

props.name: children
props.description: Anything else that belongs above the buttons.

keyboard.action: Reaches the two buttons in order; Enter or Space presses one.

a11y: `role="group"` named by the title, so the two buttons are read as belonging to one decision rather than as loose controls in a transcript.
Focus is not taken on mount unless `autoFocus` is set, and then it lands on the least destructive button. A card that grabs the keyboard is one that gets answered by accident.
`aria-busy` while `busy`, which is also when both buttons are disabled.
